text:
jas: PSA — someone's config did the interpretive dance:
```yaml
service: indexing
version: v1_0
```
priya: v1_0 is my new emo stage name :sunglasses:
marco: linter says: invalid semver 'v1_0' — underscores are feelings, not separators
lint-bot: lint error: semver violated: 'v1_0' -> suggested '1.0.0' :warning:
priya: can we make lint-bot reply with a pop-emoji when it autofixes? :sparkles:
jas: also found a file where version was commented out with existential dread: `# version: ???`
marco: team poll: prefer auto-fix to 1.0.0 or block & ask human? react with :white_check_mark: to auto-fix, :no_entry_sign: to block
priya: voted :white_check_mark: — CI saved my life once
jas: ok i'll prototype a pre-commit hook that suggests fixes, logs the diff, and posts a celebratory gif on success
lint-bot: opened issue #lint-322: handle 'v1_0' and similar band names
priya: deserved. thanks jas! :clap:
